lines.text: Moonshot posts Kimi K3.1 Pro full weights on Hugging Face; AA Index v5 still 46
Qualcomm reiterates $5B FY27 AI data-center target; Q1 guide $650M+ as Amazon ramps
Arm Q2 revenue $1.44B; data-center royalties double; AGI CPU confidence up to $2B

feed.headline: Moonshot posts Kimi K3.1 Pro full weights on Hugging Face on deadline day
feed.why: 2.8T MoE / 104B active, 1M context; public ungated repo. AA Index v5 still 46 from the API-era score.

feed.headline: Qualcomm Q4: non-GAAP revenue $10.4B; reiterates $5B FY27 data-center target
feed.why: Handsets −26%; auto record $2B. Slides: Q1 DC $650M+, exit FY27 ~$7B annualized.

feed.headline: Arm Q2 revenue $1.44B (+27%); data-center royalties double y/y
feed.why: Licensing +50%. AGI CPU confidence raised to up to $2B across FY27–28; first deliveries Q4 FY27.

feed.headline: OpenAI ships Images 2.6 with native GIFs and Flare/Sunburst API models
feed.why: Claims 50% faster gen; SVG + markup edits. Product release, not a new frontier LLM.

feed.headline: Meta acquires Conductor, a multi-agent coding workspace startup
feed.why: Cloud shuts Nov 20; local app until early 2027; Meta says a new interface early 2027.

feed.headline: Artificial Analysis scores Tencent Hy4 at 35 on Intelligence Index v5
feed.why: First independent Hy4 read. Company still said weights in coming days as of Wed.

feed.headline: Google publishes end-to-end framework for evaluating health AI
feed.why: Accuracy, safety, usefulness via benchmarks, autoraters, and expert review.

feed.headline: Qualcomm slides: Data Center Q1FY27 $650M+, exit FY27 ~$7B annualized
feed.why: Amazon multi-gen silicon + optical; warrants up to $60B potential purchases over 10 years.
